records.scope: Points-based SMC registration points require an eligible New Zealand occupational registration; registration points are based on minimum years of experience or training required to gain registration. Qualification and income are separate primary skill categories and cannot be combined with one another.

Overseas qualifications generally require an IQA unless listed on the LQEA; Level 8/9 claims generally require a bachelor's degree, with specified exceptions. Evidence requirements differ for New Zealand qualifications and supporting bachelor's degrees.
